headline: [Weekly Stock Market Outlook] KOSPI Firmly Holds 7000 Level…Leading Stocks Also Expected to Lead After Holiday
summary: The KOSPI regained the 7000 level this week amid a wait-and-see mood before the holiday. Analysts say next week's index is expected to hinge on Micron's earnings.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main stock index, heavily weighted toward semiconductor makers such as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. Micron is a major US memory-chip producer, so its results are closely watched by Korean chip stocks.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The article describes the index holding the 7000 level and its expected dependence on Micron's earnings.
